entities.description: A pristine white sandy beach stretches along the shoreline, with gentle waves lapping at the edge. The sand is smooth and undisturbed except for the shadows of palm fronds cast across it, suggesting nearby vegetation. In the background, the turquoise water is clear and calm, with two sailboats anchored offshore, their white sails contrasting against the vibrant blue-green sea. The horizon is visible in the distance, separating the water from a clear sky.

A large, fluffy cumulus cloud dominates the center of the frame, featuring a bright white, cotton-like texture with soft, billowing edges. The cloud is set against a clear, light blue sky, with smaller, fainter wisps of cloud visible in the lower left and right corners.
